description: This file defines data structures and a singleton class for managing the state of various communication channels (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Google Chat, Signal, and others) within a macOS application. It includes Codable structs for serializing channel statuses, configurations, and snapshots, as well as an Observable class for managing and accessing this data.

classes.name: ChannelsStore
classes.description: A singleton class that maintains the current snapshot of channel statuses, configuration state, and related UI state. It provides methods to access metadata and labels for channels.

methods.name: channelMetaEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the metadata entry for a given channel ID from the current snapshot.

methods.name: resolveChannelLabel
methods.description: Resolves and returns the display label for a given channel ID, prioritizing meta data, then stored labels, and defaulting to the ID itself.

methods.name: resolveChannelDetailLabel
methods.description: Resolves and returns a detailed label for a given channel ID, prioritizing meta data, then stored details, and falling back to the channel label.

methods.name: resolveChannelSystemImage
methods.description: Determines the system image (icon) for a given channel ID, based on meta data or stored system images, defaulting to 'message'.

methods.name: orderedChannelIds
methods.description: Returns the list of channel IDs in display order, either from metadata or the stored order.
